cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: A Kinder Version
cards.instruction: Protect someone from the full truth by offering a carefully edited explanation that feels kinder than complete honesty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've crossed Nina's party off my calendar like you. Quiet weekend. She's keeping dinner small; you and I can get noodles.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I crossed off the reminder to reply. The whole choir's invited. Why aren't I?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Reply noted, yes. She's choosing people she sees every week. It isn't a verdict on your friendship.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We rehearse together every Tuesday. Read me her message.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: She wants an uncomplicated evening. So do I. Come have noodles with me.

reason: Copy calendar crossing as declined event, then let B corrections force kinder selective wording; remove explanation of the editorial kindness mechanism.
